goals.title: no import cycle under src/
goals.why: orders import shipments and shipments import orders. The pair can only be understood, tested or loaded together, and neither can be moved without the other.

goals.title: the domain does not import infrastructure
goals.why: Domain rules that reach for the store cannot be exercised without one, and the store cannot be replaced without editing the rules.

goals.title: no module is longer than 45 meaningful lines
goals.why: order.mjs holds the payment rule, the totals, persistence and presentation. Four reasons to change one file.
